_meta.notes: Growth simulation configuration. All values from DESIGN.md Part 4 T01 and Part 5 specs.

root_growth_speed.notes: Root layer growth speed in units per second

canopy_growth_speed.notes: Canopy layer growth speed in units per second

max_nodes_per_plant.notes: Server-safety ceiling for max nodes per plant

growth_cooldown.notes: Cooldown between growth attempts in seconds

root_overlap_pressure_damage.notes: Damage per second applied by overlapping rival roots (HP/s)

light_blocking_per_node.notes: Light reduction per canopy node on tiles below

seed_node.notes: Seed node type definition (dormant, 0 upkeep, germinates into radicle + cotyledons). The seed's biomass IS the plant's starting biomass — it is redistributed during germination.

radicle_node.notes: Radicle (primary root tip) - first root to emerge, grows downward rapidly using seed reserves.

root_node.notes: Root node type definition. Thick taproot — high structural investment for anchoring and water/nutrient absorption. Minerals used for lignin/cellulose cell walls.

lateral_root_node.notes: Lateral root node definition. Branches from primary root pericycle — finer, higher absorption surface.

stem_node.notes: Stem node type definition. Woody structural element — moderate investment, high integrity. High minerals for lignin.

branch_node.notes: Branch node type definition. Lateral branch from axillary bud — slightly cheaper than main stem.

leaf_node.notes: Leaf node type definition. Thin photosynthetic organ — cheap to produce, high ROI. Only leaf nodes photosynthesize. Low minerals for leaf structure.

cotyledon_node.notes: Cotyledon (seed leaf) node definition. First photosynthetic organs — slightly less efficient than true leaves, temporary. Shed when plant has 4+ true leaves.

flower_node.notes: Flower node type definition. Complex reproductive structure — most expensive non-root node, high upkeep. Produces heirloom seeds.

spore_sac_node.notes: Spore sac node type definition. Reproductive structure — moderate investment, produces spores for dispersal.

vine_node.notes: Vine node type definition. Thin climbing stem — cheaper than woody stem, high horizontal spread.

growth_intent_cooldown.notes: Client growth intent rate limit in seconds

root_attack_damage_multiplier.notes: Multiplier for root attack damage vs passive overlap pressure

germination_min_moisture.notes: Hard success threshold: local tile moisture (0-100) must be at least this value for the seed to sprout. A player may still attempt below it; the seed dies instead (ADR-026).

germination_min_light.notes: Hard success threshold: local light (0-100) must be at least this value for the seed to sprout. A player may still attempt below it; the seed dies instead (ADR-026).

germination_failure_kills_seed.notes: When true, a germination attempt below the moisture/light thresholds destroys the seed/plant. Lets a player deliberately kill a seed (ADR-026).

photosynthesis_energy_per_second.notes: Base energy production per leaf per second at max light/moisture/minerals

energy_upkeep_per_biomass.notes: Energy upkeep cost per unit biomass per second

growth_water_consumption_rate.notes: Water consumed per second of growth time per unit biomass cost

growth_nutrient_consumption_rate.notes: Nutrients (N/P/K) consumed per second of growth time per unit biomass cost

growth_mineral_consumption_rate.notes: Minerals consumed per second of growth time per unit biomass cost. Minerals = structural building blocks (calcium for cell walls, magnesium for chlorophyll, silica for rigidity, trace elements for enzymes).

growth_min_water.notes: Minimum tile water level (0-100) for growth to proceed. Below this, growth pauses.

growth_min_nutrients.notes: Minimum tile nutrient level (0-100) for growth to proceed. Below this, growth pauses.

growth_min_minerals.notes: Minimum tile mineral level (0-100) for growth to proceed. Below this, growth pauses.
